title: VOICE TYPING: MICROPHONE PERMISSION
summary: Having trouble with Voice Typing or mic not responding? Please ensure Orbit Board has been granted Microphone permission in your device's App Info.
highlights: 🎙️ How to Grant: Long-press Orbit Board app icon on home screen -> App info -> Permissions -> Microphone -> Choose 'Allow only while using the app'
⚙️ Alternative: Open phone Settings -> Apps -> Orbit Board -> Permissions -> Enable Microphone
🔇 Click Sound Mute: Prefer silent voice typing? Go to Orbit Board Settings -> Typing -> Mute Voice Typing Sound
🔒 Private & Offline: Orbit Board is 100% offline. Voice data is processed entirely on-device and never transmitted

title: ORBIT BOARD v1.2.3: MAJOR UPDATE & REDESIGN
summary: Orbit Board v1.2.3 is live! Featuring a complete Nothing OS UI redesign, integrated Voice Typing, instant Bengali Number Pad toggle, real-time keyboard resizer, and adaptive theme styling.
highlights: 🎙️ Voice Typing Added: Fast, private on-device voice input directly on the action bar with mute click sound toggle
🎨 Complete UI Redesign: Authentic Nothing OS & Bauhaus aesthetic, floating bottom navigation dock, proportional preview cards, and dot-matrix typography
🔢 Instant Bangla Number Pad: One-tap toggle key (১২৩ / 123) on the dialpad to switch between English & Bengali digits
📐 Real-Time Keyboard Resizer: Live visual feedback and interactive preview while adjusting keyboard height and margins
🌈 Theme-Adaptive Spacebar Accent: Spacebar color dynamically matches the active theme's accent color (Enter & Emoji keys)
🇧🇩 Full Bengali Typing Suite: Avro Phonetic, Probhat with [ ্য | য | র্য ] popup panel, Jatiyo Modern, Jatiyo Classic, and Alphabetical Bangla
🔔 Push Update Notifications: Automatic background update checking with Android status bar notifications
⚡ Major Optimization: Faster startup, lower memory footprint, and rock-solid stability
